Thanh Chu

Software Engineering Student — Building on 15+ Years of Cross-Industry Experience

Software Engineering student at Blekinge Institute of Technology (BTH), Sweden, transitioning into tech after a career spanning banking operations, finance, and early childhood education. Comfortable working across the stack — from backend services and databases to CI/CD, monitoring, and containerised deployments.

About me

I am a Software Engineering student at BTH, Sweden, transitioning into tech after 15+ years in banking, finance, and early childhood education. I bring a rare combination of hands-on coding skills, disciplined process thinking, and strong communication ability — proven by delivering a student project for Ericsson, leading client demos, and being personally selected to lead exercise sessions for first-year students.

Comfortable working across the stack: backend services, databases, CI/CD, monitoring, and containerised deployments.
